data.name: Detection is a tracing aid, not proof of misconduct. Cropping, resizing, screenshots and print/scan can destroy the watermark. No match does not prove the image is unmarked.
data.value: 检测仅辅助追溯，不是滥用行为的证据。裁剪、缩放、截图和打印扫描可能破坏水印。没有检测结果不能说明图片没有水印。

data.name: Upload a PNG/JPEG copy (at most 20 MB) to inspect its embedded tracking ID. Images are uploaded to a private temporary folder and deleted after inspection; abandoned uploads are cleaned after one hour.
data.value: 上传 PNG/JPEG 副本（不超过 20 MB），检测其中的隐形追踪编号。图片先存入私有临时目录，检测后即删除；放弃使用的上传文件超过一小时后定期清理。

data.name: The image to inspect is required.
Please upload a valid image to inspect.
data.value: 请上传有效的待检测图片。

data.name: A tracking ID matches an issuance record. This result alone is not proof of misuse by the applicant.
data.value: 检测到追踪编号并找到对应生成记录。该结果不能单独证明申请人实施了滥用。

data.name: No verifiable issuance record was found. An unmarked image, image transformations or damage may prevent detection; no match does not establish its origin.
data.value: 未找到可验证的对应记录。无水印、图像变换或水印损坏都可能导致检测失败，不能据此判断来源。
